label: thm:borromean-word-minimal
title: The Borromean word is the shortest non-trivial pure zero-linking three-braid
html:
Let \beta_{\mathrm{Bor}} = (\sigma_0\sigma_1^{-1})^3 \in B_3. Call a word in \sigma_0^{\pm 1}, \sigma_1^{\pm 1} pure zero-linking if its permutation is the identity and each of its three pairwise linking numbers is 0. Among freely reduced pure zero-linking words:

  1. every word of length at most 5 is empty;
  2. every word of length 6 is either the identity of B_3 or conjugate in B_3 to \beta_{\mathrm{Bor}};
  3. \beta_{\mathrm{Bor}} \neq 1 in B_3.

Proof

Items 1 and 2 are a finite check over all reduced words of length at most 6. At length 6 there are 16 such words. Four of them are \beta_{\mathrm{Bor}}, its cyclic rotation, its mirror and the mirror's rotation; these are conjugate, because exchanging \sigma_0 \leftrightarrow \sigma_1 is conjugation by \Delta = \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0. The other twelve are rotations of \Delta\,\Delta'^{-1} with \Delta' = \sigma_1\sigma_0\sigma_1, which is the identity by the braid relation. For item 3, the Burau representation at t = -1 sends \beta_{\mathrm{Bor}} to the matrix with rows (13, 8) and (8, 5).
